question: How do current multimessenger constraints from IceCube follow-ups of LIGO–Virgo gravitational-wave events, together with theoretical models of compact-object merger outflows and previous neutrino non-detections, shape our understanding of the conditions under which neutron-star and black-hole mergers can produce detectable high-energy neutrino emission?

How do CME kinematics and geometry, shock Mach number evolution, magnetic connectivity, and flare/eruption-associated seed particle release collectively determine whether fast and wide CMEs produce observable >20 MeV SEP events across multi-spacecraft heliospheric observations?

How do data-driven abundance inferences from medium-resolution Gaia RVS spectra, high-resolution spectroscopic studies of solar twins, and exoplanet host demographic surveys collectively constrain whether refractory-element depletion in Sun-like stars is causally linked to terrestrial or giant planet formation rather than to Galactic chemical evolution, stellar age, or selection effects?

How do differing treatments of the extragalactic DM–redshift relation, telescope selection functions, and intrinsic FRB energy and redshift distributions across CHIME/FRB and well-localized FRB studies affect conclusions about whether the FRB volumetric rate traces cosmic star formation history or requires additional evolutionary channels?

How do current simultaneous optical–radio non-detections of repeating FRBs, including the deep Tomo-e Gozen/FAST limits for FRB 20190520B, compare with prior multiwavelength constraints and theoretical emission models to delimit the allowed parameter space for prompt optical counterparts produced by magnetospheric inverse Compton scattering or magnetar blastwave interactions?

How do observations and models across multiple filament-eruption events support or challenge the roles of tether-cutting reconnection, magnetic flux-rope twist accumulation, and helical kink instability in driving the transition from confined filament reconfiguration to fast coronal mass ejection eruption?

How do analytic and simulation-based treatments of the halo splashback boundary, excursion-set diffusion, and cosmology-dependent mass accretion histories collectively explain the redshift evolution of the splashback mass function and its potential use as an independent constraint on primordial cosmological parameters?

How do wavelength-dependent surface albedo retrieval frameworks for directly imaged terrestrial exoplanets compare across the literature in their ability to distinguish biogenic spectral edges, such as Earth’s vegetation red edge, from confounding atmospheric, cloud, mineral, and instrumental effects?

How do turbulence driving modes, plasma beta, and turbulent Mach number jointly regulate shock statistics and turbulent energy dissipation across astrophysical plasmas such as the ISM and ICM, as inferred from numerical simulations, observations, and theoretical models of magnetized turbulence?

How do particle acceleration and transport mechanisms in null-point magnetic reconnection during coronal jets compare across MHD test-particle simulations, flare ribbon observations, and in-situ heliospheric particle measurements in explaining spatially separated proton and electron precipitation and beam formation?

How do high-resolution 3D dust maps based on deep optical–near-infrared stellar photometry, such as the DECaPS map of the southern Galactic plane, compare with Gaia-based, infrared-emission-based, and earlier Bayesian extinction maps in resolving spiral-arm structure, constraining Galactic star formation environments, and correcting extinction across the full Milky Way disk?

How do differences in filament-identification algorithms, redshift-space distortion treatments, viewing-angle selection criteria, and filament dynamical properties across observational and simulation studies affect the robustness and physical interpretation of reported spin signals in cosmic web filaments?

How do mode switching, emission-height variations, and frequency-dependent spectral-index distributions in PSR J0614+2229 compare with those observed in other mode-changing pulsars, and what do these comparisons imply about the magnetospheric mechanisms governing pulsar emission-state transitions?

How do nonlinear torsional Alfvén-wave cascades, shock formation, density contrast, plasma-β, and field-aligned flow shear jointly regulate energy dissipation, coronal heating, observability of solar jets at different heights, and solar-wind acceleration across theoretical, numerical, and observational studies?

How do observations and simulations of high-redshift protoclusters compare in explaining the relative roles of dry major mergers, environmental quenching, and cluster-core assembly in the early formation of brightest cluster galaxies like the quiescent pair in BOSS1244 at \(z \approx 2.24\)?

How do methanol abundances and formation pathways across varying galactocentric radii, metallicities, cloud densities, and temperatures compare with those of other complex organic molecules, and what do these trends imply for refining models of the Galactic Habitable Zone?

How do radial variations in the age–velocity dispersion relations of thin- and thick-disk stars inferred from LAMOST–Gaia red clump samples compare with theoretical and observational evidence for disk heating by giant molecular clouds, spiral structure, radial migration, inside-out/upside-down formation, and merger perturbations such as Sagittarius?

How do laboratory rotational spectroscopy data for sulfur- and nitrogen-bearing alkynyl molecules, together with astrochemical models and prior molecular-line surveys of sources such as Sgr B2(N), NGC 6334I, G+0.693−0.027, and TMC-1, constrain the formation pathways, expected abundances, and detectability of HCCSCN in interstellar environments?

How do atmospheric retrievals and global circulation models across irradiated brown dwarfs and hot/ultra-hot Jupiters reconcile observed phase-dependent temperature inversions, H⁻ opacity, and viewing-geometry effects in shaping dayside–nightside spectral contrasts?

How do uncertainties and discrepancies among stellar atmosphere models in the mid-infrared propagate into the interpretation of JWST secondary-eclipse emission spectra of terrestrial exoplanets, particularly in distinguishing surface composition, albedo, and atmospheric presence compared with analogous stellar-contamination effects previously characterized in transmission spectroscopy?

How do CO-line kinematic diagnostics, spatial morphology, and distance constraints across studies of supernova remnants interacting with molecular clouds refine the criteria for distinguishing genuine SNR–MC associations from chance line-of-sight correlations, as illustrated by the ∼50 km s⁻¹ versus ∼5 km s⁻¹ components toward SNR G43.9+1.6?

How do the merger fractions and morphological disturbance signatures observed in changing-look AGN host galaxies compare with those of the broader AGN population across different accretion states and triggering mechanisms?

How does the metallicity threshold inferred from the cosmic rate evolution of long gamma-ray bursts compare with independent constraints derived from host galaxy metallicity measurements, stellar evolution models, and progenitor formation channels across different studies?

How does the interpretation of transition region plasma as being magnetically and thermally connected to the corona, rather than composed of thermally isolated cool loops, reconcile with the diverse and often conflicting models of transition region structure and energy balance proposed across the past several decades of solar physics literature?

How do the period–Wesenheit relation coefficients and parallax zeropoint corrections derived from open-cluster-associated classical Cepheids compare across different calibration methods, photometric bands, and metallicity treatments in the broader literature, and what are the implications of these differences for resolving the Hubble tension?

How do the observed characteristics of He-deficient dwarf novae below the period minimum, such as KSP-OT-201712a, constrain the various proposed evolutionary channels leading to AM CVn systems and helium cataclysmic variables?

How do the mass–size scaling relations and morphological transitions of molecular clouds derived from 3D dust extinction maps reconcile with those obtained through molecular line and dust emission tracers across different galactic environments, and what do such discrepancies reveal about the relative roles of galactic shear, self-gravity, and observational selection effects in shaping cloud structure?

How do the spin constraints derived from EHT brightness asymmetry measurements in MAD accretion models compare with independent spin estimates obtained through jet power, jet morphology, and cosmological black hole growth studies, and to what extent do these methods converge on a consistent value for M87*'s spin?

How do the measured intrinsic abundance scatters in metal-poor dwarf galaxies and globular clusters compare with predictions from chemical evolution models and hydrodynamical simulations that account for varying early star formation histories, supernova yields, and interstellar medium mixing timescales?

How do the mechanisms governing inertial and kinetic Alfvén wave transmission through Alfvén speed gradients compare across space, laboratory, and astrophysical plasma regimes, and what candidate damping processes could account for the observed energy loss not attributable to reflection?

How do the constraints on initial giant planet multiplicity, migration rates, and eccentricity damping efficiency derived from dynamical instability models compare with independent estimates from planet-disk interaction simulations, protoplanetary disk observations, and demographic surveys of exoplanetary systems?

How do different approaches to uncertainty quantification and model ambiguity across coupled planetary thermal-evolution and climate models influence the reliability of long-term habitability forecasts for terrestrial exoplanets?

How do the atmospheric dynamics, habitability predictions, and observational detectability of Proxima b vary across different general circulation models and assumed atmospheric compositions, and what factors account for the discrepancies among these studies?

How do systematic uncertainties in lens mass modeling assumptions, such as the mass-sheet degeneracy and choice of density profile parameterization, propagate into ensemble-level Hubble constant inference across different time-delay cosmography methods?

How do the assumptions underlying the radio–infrared correlation and its potential evolution with redshift affect the reliability of predicted radio–FIR continuum SEDs for high-redshift galaxies across different telescope surveys?

How do the detection rates and methodological constraints of X-ray periodicity searches for supermassive black hole binaries compare with those from other observational approaches—such as optical time-domain surveys and pulsar timing arrays—across the electromagnetic and gravitational-wave spectrum?

How do contemporary real-time alert systems and their underlying predictive algorithms compare in their efficacy to forecast multiwavelength afterglow properties from prompt gamma-ray observations across diverse satellite constellations?
